pages.text: Use a regular furnace and $(l:psychedelicraft:growing/coffea)coffea cherries$(/l).
Combine an empty stone cup, a water bucket and two coffee beans in the crafting grid. Take the 250 mB cup of cold coffee. The empty bucket returns.
Use a regular furnace to heat the filled cup. A pass raises the warmth one step. Run it through twice for hot coffee. The cup still contains the same amount.
Two coffee beans plus an empty syringe produce one filled caffeine syringe. See $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/caffeine)what the caffeine profiles do$(/l).
